note: Reconciliation of this tracker's announced layoff totals vs external trackers/press, per company. 'ours' is computed from events.json (sum of layoff sizes since 2022). 'external' is what Layoffs.fyi / wire press report. Differences are expected: trackers count rolling per-team cuts we don't capture, and our numbers include announced buyout offers (Microsoft 60,000) which trackers may count differently.

rows.external: Layoffs.fyi/press: ~57,000 since 2022 (CNBC, Jan 2026); 30,000 corporate in Oct 2025 + Jan 2026 rounds
rows.note: Ours adds the Oct 2026 stores/devices trimming (~1,000 est.); trackers may not.
Buyout offers are announced offers, not realized separations — see METHODOLOGY.

rows.external: Only the Jan 2023 12,000 is company-announced; 2026 rolling cuts estimated 1,500-3,000+ by trackers (no official total)
rows.note: Largest known undercount — Google never announces a 2026 total; we carry the outside estimate as medium confidence.

rows.external: Layoffs.fyi: 21,000 in FY2026 (largest single-company tally of 2026), per FY2026 10-K
rows.note: Matches; gross terminations reported up to ~30,000 across waves.

rows.external: Layoffs.fyi/Statista: ~22,000 announced Apr 2025 (20%) + 15,000 Aug 2024; headcount fell 131,900 -> 85,100 (2022-2025)
rows.note: We count the two company-announced rounds (15,000 each); the Apr 2025 20% round overlaps the Jul 2025 target — scope notes explain.

rows.external: Apr 2024 'more than 10%' (~14,000); Apr 2026 press: further 22% cut wave reported
rows.note: Apr 2026 wave is press-reported; add when a company-confirmed number lands.

rows.external: Layoffs.fyi: ~900,000 since 2020 (~128,536 in 2026 by Sep 10); Skillsyncer: 232,946+ by Sep 19, 2026 — industry-wide, all companies
